blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu Province is establishing a multi-sectoral technical team to help the provincial solid waste board track how cities and municipalities manage their waste and identify areas needing intervention. The Technical Working Group (TWG) was created through Resolution No. 2026-02 of the Cebu Provincial Solid Waste Management Board (CPSWMB). It’s meant to provide technical support for the province’s solid waste management efforts. Cebu Gov. Pamela S. Baricuatro signed it on Aug. 19, 2026. The group will examine the waste management plans of local government units (LGUs). It will assess how these programs are implemented. READ: Cebu waste crisis: […]...
